annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a new Chapter VI on express packaging requiring compliance with mandatory national standards and avoiding over-packaging.
Requires courier firms to adopt packaging operation rules and packaging recycling systems, and to report single-use plastic use to postal authorities.
Sets fines of RMB 5,000–20,000 for failing to implement packaging rules or recycling systems.
Adds a general principle for the express industry: market-led, safe, innovation-driven and coordinated development.
The decision takes effect 1 June 2025; the consolidated regulation covers licensing, safety inspection and user information protection.
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 806 amends China's Interim Regulations on Express Delivery, adding a chapter on green and reduced express packaging, mandatory packaging standards, recycling and plastic-use reporting, with penalties. Effective 1 June 2025. The consolidated text of the regulation is reproduced. It has no AI or robotics governance content.
